subject: gk
question: During which year was the first Industrial Policy Resolution passed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1948**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first **Industrial Policy Resolution** was passed in the year **1948**.
 
• This resolution marked the beginning of a planned industrial development in **India**.
 
• The 1948 resolution laid down the foundation for the **mixed economy** model in India, where both the **public and private sectors** would co-exist and contribute to industrial growth.
 
• The resolution classified industries into three categories: **strategic industries** (to be exclusively managed by the state), **basic and key industries** (to be progressively state-managed), and **other industries** (to be left to private enterprise).
 
• The 1948 policy aimed at **promoting industrial growth**, reducing regional disparities, and ensuring equitable distribution of wealth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Industrial Policy Resolution of 1956** further elaborated on the policies initiated in 1948 and laid down a more comprehensive strategy for industrial development.
 
• The 1956 resolution categorized industries into three schedules based on the degree of state control and involvement.
 
• The **Industrial Policy Statement of 1977** focused on the promotion of small-scale and cottage industries.
 
• The **New Industrial Policy of 1991** introduced liberalization, privatization, and globalization measures, reducing the state's role in industrial regulation and allowing greater freedom for private enterprise.
